Plot standardised residuals against length

Source: R/BLICC_Plots.R
plot_residuals.Rd

The graph shows the standardised residuals plotted against length for all gears combined, separated by colour. Due to the variance weighting, outliers can most be expected at the tails of the frequency. For the MCMC output, the residuals are plotted as 99% quartiles using error bars, together with the outliers as points outside this range.

Usage

plot_residuals(blicc_rp, gear = "All", time_period = "All")

Arguments

blicc_rp

A list of posterior draws, reference points with associated direction, the data object and expected lengths from blicc_ref_pts function.

gear

Specifies the gear(s) to plot as an integer index or full name

time_period

Specifies the period(s) to plot as an integer index or full name

Value

ggplot geom object plotting standardised residuals

Details

If you want to alter the graph, the group names are Sgroup for the selectivities and Lgroup for the lengths.

Examples

plot_residuals(trgl_rp)
